gpu.example.com
  labels:
    tier=gold
    vendor=example
  selectors: 2
    1. device.driver == "gpu.example.com" && device.attributes["gpu.example.com"].leakmarker
    2. device.capacity["gpu.example.com"].memory.isGreaterThan(quantity("1Gi"))
  config: gpu.example.com
